notes: Read the 81-line source file line by line before editing and ported the feedbackKeys factories, FeedbackListParams, buildQuery, useSubmitFeedback, useFeedbackList, and useUpdateFeedback.

Inlined the FeedbackEntry, FeedbackListResponse, FeedbackSubmitInput, FeedbackUpdateInput, FeedbackCategory, and FeedbackStatus DTOs from web/src/api/types.ts because the native parity layer has no shared web-parity api/types module for this hook.
Preserved the source API paths without an /api/v1 prefix: POST /feedback, GET /admin/feedback with status/category/limit/offset query parameters, and PATCH /admin/feedback/{id}.
Adapted buildQuery from URLSearchParams.set to append because the React Native TypeScript surface exposes append; each key is still emitted at most once, preserving the source query string behavior.

Source is non-visual API/type hook code; native output uses the React Native-safe parity request client, forwards TanStack Query AbortSignal values, preserves keepPreviousData placeholder behavior, and preserves mutation toast keys/fallbacks through the native Alert bridge.
No unit conversion, browser-only behavior, DOM elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components exist in this source hook; hook data remains raw API data for native consumers.
